action.sql: SELECT g.dept_id, d.name AS department, SUM(g.debit - g.credit) AS operating_expense FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = g.dept_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'US01' AND g.period = '2026-05' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND CAST(g.account_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6000 AND 6999 GROUP BY g.dept_id, d.name ORDER BY g.dept_id
